topic.title: Strategic Environmental Assessment / Sustainability Appraisal / Plan Adoption
topic.source_contract: plan scope, legal assessment duty, screening, baseline, objectives, reasonable alternatives, consultation bodies, environmental report, significant effects, mitigation, monitoring, modifications, adoption statement and post-adoption review evidence

scope_guards: A plan draft is not an adopted statutory plan.
A screening opinion is not a completed sustainability appraisal.
Consultation is not evidence that reasonable alternatives were assessed.
An environmental report is not an adoption decision.
Proposed mitigation is not completed mitigation.
An adopted plan is not proof of site-specific permission.
Monitoring indicators are not measured outcomes.
No score or promotion is written without exact plan status, assessment, adoption and monitoring evidence.
